top_signals.title: European Bond Selloff Deepens as ECB Flags Inflation Risks
top_signals.summary: A selloff in European bonds extended after European Central Bank President Christine Lagarde flagged risks to inflation, adding to investors’ ongoing concerns about elevated energy prices.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Central-bank repricing affecting yields, FX, liquidity and equities.

top_signals.title: Hormuz Fuel Exports’ Slow Recovery Keeps Prices Near Record
top_signals.summary: Oil-product exports through the Strait of Hormuz are slowly recovering, but the pace hasn’t been enough to prevent a surge in fuel prices that is squeezing consumers around the world.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: China sells J-10C fighter jet to Uzbekistan, eyes more markets for weapons
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: Existing Home Sales Fall to Weakest in More Than a Year
top_signals.summary: Sales of previously owned homes in the US slowed last month to their weakest pace in more than a year. Michael McKee reports on "Bloomberg Open Interest." (Source: Bloomberg)
